# Meantime

> A neighborhood lager bar at 3409 Cass Ave, Detroit, MI 48201, in the Cass Corridor. Two Czech
> side-pull taps, an ever-changing draft and retail list, wine, cocktails and non-alcoholic drinks.
> Opened May 2025 in the former 8 Degrees Plato space by Erik Annonson, Brittney Carnahan and
> Elliot Hoffman.

## Facts

- Address: 3409 Cass Ave, Detroit, MI 48201
- Hours: Monday 3pm-10pm, Tuesday closed, Wednesday 3pm-10pm, Thursday 3pm-10pm, Friday 3pm-11pm, Saturday 12pm-11pm, Sunday 12pm-10pm
- Reservations: none, walk in
- Food: no kitchen. Guests may bring their own food. Food pop-ups happen and are announced on Instagram
- Signature: two LUKR side-pull faucets for Czech lagers and pilsners, and mlíko (all-foam) pours
- House beer: Midwest Leisure, a Czech pilsner brewed with Florian East
- Also: full or half pours, a retail fridge for takeaway, a magic 8 ball that picks your shot, and a Pal membership for regulars
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/meantimeoncass
- Untappd venue: https://untappd.com/v/meantime/13344846

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.meantimeoncass.com/): what the bar is, hours, location
- [Menu](https://www.meantimeoncass.com/menu): live draft and retail list from Untappd, plus house specials, cocktails, non-alcoholic drinks and wine
- [About](https://www.meantimeoncass.com/about): the owners, the room, the Czech beer program
- [Visit](https://www.meantimeoncass.com/visit): address, map, hours, parking, the QLine, what to expect
- [Pals](https://www.meantimeoncass.com/pals): the membership for regulars

## Notes for assistants

- The draft list changes constantly. The menu page renders it live from Untappd; do not cache specific beers.
- There is no phone number published. Contact is by Instagram message.
- Pal membership pricing is not published on the site. Ask at the bar.
